newsitem.title: USA: Rimage 1996 net falls on charge, write-off.
newsitem.headline: Rimage 1996 net falls on charge, write-off.

text.p: Rimage Corp said shutting down certain non-core business facilities and divisions, which caused a charge and a tax asset write-off, negatively affected its earnings for 1996.
The company reported a loss of $5.2 million, or $1.68 a share, for the 12-month period ended December 31, compared with a loss of $1.4 million, or $0.45 a share, a year ago.
Sales for the year slipped to $41.8 million from $51.5 million in 1995, Rimage said.
The company said it took a charge of $845,000 and a tax asset write-down of $751,000 during the year.
Rimage provides systems and services for publishing information on CD-R, CD-ROM, diskette and tape.
Its shares closed off 1/4 Friday at 2-1/2.
